rootCause: Page navigation did not complete before the test attempted validation or interaction.
suggestedFixes: Wait for page navigation to complete before interacting with elements
Use page.waitForURL() for expected route changes
Avoid asserting dashboard elements immediately after login submit

keywords: context or browser has been closed
rootCause: Browser page or context was closed before the pending Playwright action completed.
suggestedFixes: Ensure context.close() is awaited only after test execution completes
Avoid pending actions after test timeout

Prefer stable role-based or test-id based locators

Check test data used for this scenario
